hook_segment.text: כולם מדברים על זה וסוף סוף הזמנתי...

causes_to_rate.a: Weak opening visual — flat catalog shot, no motion cue
causes_to_rate.c: AliExpress catalog feel — reads as a marketplace thumbnail, not organic TikTok
causes_to_rate.d: Generic hook text — no specific number/problem/surprise
causes_to_rate.e: Hook–product mismatch — text promises something the image doesn't show
causes_to_rate.h: Non-native Hebrew phrasing — grammatically valid but reads as translated/stilted

a.evidence: Same shared footage as the other three variants: 0s, 0.5s, 1s and 1.5s frames are the identical static lifestyle photo (white + pink bag-sealers, plant, placemat, fork) with zero detectable motion across a full 1.5 seconds.

b.evidence: The two bag-sealer units are clearly visible and centered in frame from 0s.

c.evidence: By 2s the video cuts to the same raw AliExpress listing-page screenshot as 003A/B/C -- 'אבטחה ופרטיות', 'החזרות חינם', 'מסירה: יוני 25', and the yellow 'רק עד 8 בעלי אקספרס' urgency banner are all visible marketplace UI, not stylized product photography, and this appears inside the measured hook window.

d.evidence: Hook text 'כולם מדברים על זה וסוף סוף הזמנתי...' ('Everyone's talking about it and I finally ordered...') is a pure generic social-proof template -- no product function, number, or specific problem is named. Interchangeable with almost any trending-product video.

e.evidence: The text sets up an 'I finally ordered it / here it is' unboxing-style narrative, but the frames show a static, staged lifestyle photo (not an unboxing) and then cut away entirely to an unrelated AliExpress screenshot rather than following through on a delivery/ordering payoff.

h.evidence: 'כולם מדברים על זה וסוף סוף הזמנתי' is natural, colloquial spoken Hebrew, a common authentic TikTok phrasing pattern -- not stilted or translated.

step11d_divergence_note: No STEP 11D pre-launch QA data exists for product 003 (confirmed via the upload package containing STEP 3C but no STEP 11D section), so no prediction-vs-reality divergence applies here. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: this variant has only 2 total views, so its first_2_second_retention of 0.45 (MARGINAL) is based on essentially 1-2 viewers and is flagged LOW_CONFIDENCE for any retention-outcome correlation -- the number should not be treated as a reliable signal of how this hook performs at scale. The visual/textual findings above (identical static-photo-into-AliExpress-screenshot footage shared with all other 003 variants, generic social-proof hook text) are real, verifiable creative-quality observations independent of view count, but they cannot be claimed to have 'caused' this specific retention number at n=2.
